title: Tools of Destruction
note: Per-title inputs of tools/spu/spu_lift.py. Numbers recovered from the decrypted EBOOT (BCUS98127). pm_seed: the policy module's interrupt handler (the SPURS kernel jumps to it, nothing in the code calls it). wws_code_slot: the LS address of the job code buffer the policy module reads (lqa at LS 0x3024), patches 6500/6501; absent = the runtime default 0x1320. lift_table: code ends and data islands of the modules whose first lift had unsupported words (tools/survey/lift_table.py).
